capabilities: Zooms the graph view around the midpoint of two fingers
Pans the view when both fingers move together
Suppresses drag interpretation while two fingers touch the graph
Releases a grabbed note when the second finger lands
Leaves one-finger drag, mouse and scroll wheel behavior unchanged
extras: Uses undocumented graph view internals, so a future Obsidian update could break pinch-zoom; desktop Windows touchscreens only, since mobile already has pinch-zoom.
intentEvidence: On Windows, the desktop app doesn't: two fingers on the graph just drag it around.
problem: On Windows touchscreens, Obsidian's graph view reads two-finger pinches as a drag, so there is no pinch-zoom like on mobile.
summary: Plugin that adds two-finger pinch zoom and pan to Obsidian's graph view on Windows touchscreens.
